title: Retargeting Social Media Outreach for SNAP Take-Up
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a single common treatment date. Replication_code.ipynb cell 8: treat = 1 for experimental groups 1-3 and 6 (control groups 4-5), eventyear maps the six data waves to -2..3 with 2021-12-01 = 0 for everyone, post = eventyear > -1, posttreat = post x treat. SNAP_analysis.R runs feols(y ~ posttreat | tracknumber^english + date^english) and the event-study analogue i(eventyear, treatment, -1). One adoption date, so not staggered.
design_notes: R fixest called from a Python notebook via rpy2. Individual panel of 16,510 people x 6 waves (99,060 rows) of LA DPSS SNAP enrollment. Outcomes: currentlyonsnap, dropped_off, withdrew_drop, back_on. Figure 2 event study; Table D.1 (appendix) static DiD. The did package is loaded but not used for a staggered estimator.
data_files_note: De-identified LA DPSS enrollment panel shipped; README says it suffices to replicate all results.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). RCT with common start date; not a staggered adoption design.
